individuallyAssessableRequirements.evidence: WOWList, Sunday Dinner / 196, and NYC Artist Coalition / FairRentNYC each provide concrete continuities, detailed below.

Organizer language shapes publication; an artist's needs shape a residency handoff; listening meetings shape collective action and decision memory. These are mechanisms for participation and continuation rather than abstract administrative claims.

Shared builder and organizer credit, participant-level exclusions, and limits on campaign causality are explicit. Open House is a brief cited summary; no raw article, faculty evaluation, or private testimonial was present in reviewed materials.
